select oneid.id, oneid.one_id, oneid.shop_name,case oneid.yili_status when 0 then '关闭' when 1 then '在售' else '' end yiliStatus, case oneid.one_id_type when '0' then ( case oneid.poi_status when '0' then '关闭' when '2' then '即将关闭' else '在售' end ) else '' end AS poiStatus,oneid.province, oneid.province_code, oneid.city, oneid.city_code, oneid.district, oneid.district_code,
        oneid.town, oneid.town_code, oneid.village, oneid.village_code, oneid.address,
        oneid.longitude, oneid.latitude, oneid.channel_type, oneid.channel_type_code, oneid.channel_second_type, oneid.channel_second_type_code, oneid.shop_distribution,
        oneid.shop_area,case oneid.chain_or_not when '-1' then '' when '0' then '' when '1' then '是' end chain_or_not,
        oneid.brand_name, oneid.brand_code, oneid.business_circle, env_code_merge, env_name_merge, yuntu_tag,
        case heat_type when 0 then '是' when 1 then '否' end heat_type,
        CASE heat_value WHEN -1 THEN NULL ELSE FLOOR(heat_value) END AS heat_value,
        case rating when -1.00 then NULL else rating end as rating,
        open_time, tel,
        case collection_time when '-1' then '' else collection_time end as collection_time,
        oneid.head_photo, DATE_FORMAT(oneid.modified_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') update_time,
        case oneid.one_id_type when 0 then '是' when 1 then '否' end as one_id_type
        from busi_shop_one_id oneid
        where oneid.delete_flag=0
         
         
          
          
     
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
          
     
        order by modified_time desc LIMIT 10

order by b.pro_area,a.PRO_CODE

SELECT
        
        a.pay_time_month AS currentMonth,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id_a) AS newCustomers,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(b.pay_time,'%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(a.pay_time_month, '-01'),'%Y%m')) = 1 THEN b.user_id ELSE NULL END) AS firstMonthRemain,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(b.pay_time,'%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(a.pay_time_month, '-01'),'%Y%m')) = 2 THEN b.user_id ELSE NULL END) AS secondMonthRemain,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(b.pay_time,'%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(a.pay_time_month, '-01'),'%Y%m')) = 3 THEN b.user_id ELSE NULL END) AS thirdMonthRemain,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(b.pay_time,'%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(a.pay_time_month, '-01'),'%Y%m')) = 4 THEN b.user_id ELSE NULL END) AS fourthMonthRemain,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(b.pay_time,'%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(a.pay_time_month, '-01'),'%Y%m')) = 5 THEN b.user_id ELSE NULL END) AS fifthMonthRemain,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(b.pay_time,'%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(a.pay_time_month, '-01'),'%Y%m')) = 6 THEN b.user_id ELSE NULL END) AS sixthMonthRemain
        FROM
        (
        SELECT DISTINCT
        DATE_FORMAT(MIN(pay_time),'%Y-%m') AS pay_time_month,
        user_id AS user_id_a
        FROM `tz_order`
        WHERE is_payed = 1
         
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY pay_time_month
        ) a
        LEFT JOIN `tz_order` b ON a.user_id_a = b.user_id AND b.is_payed = 1
         
        GROUP BY a.pay_time_month
         
            HAVING (a.pay_time_month >= '2025-02-19 00:00:00' AND a.pay_time_month <= '2026-02-19 23:59:59.999')

)b on a.合同ID=b.ContractsID and a.项目名称=b.Pro_Code

SELECT
        COALESCE(sum(if(cc.consume_type in(1,2,3,6,7,8),cc.class_consume_amount,null)),0) +
        COALESCE(sum(if(cc.consume_type=11 AND cc.src_consume_type IN(1,2,3) ,cc.class_consume_amount,null)),0)
        consumeAmount,
        COALESCE(sum(if(cc.consume_type in(4,5,9,10),cc.class_consume_amount,null)),0) +
        COALESCE(sum(if(cc.consume_type=11 AND cc.src_consume_type IN(4,5,6) ,cc.class_consume_amount,null)),0)
        noMakeupAmount,
        cc.business_id
        FROM
        (SELECT DISTINCT
        pcc.id,
        pcc.consume_type,
        pcc.class_consume_amount,
        pcc.business_id,
        src.consume_type as src_consume_type
        FROM
        pc_class_consume pcc
        LEFT JOIN pc_class_consume src ON src.record_id = pcc.source_record_id
         
         
         
        WHERE
        pcc.deleted = 0
         
         
     
         
            and pcc.business_id IN
             (  
                1
             , 
                2
             , 
                3
             ) 
         
         
         
         
            and pcc.consume_time >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
         
         
            and pcc.consume_time   <=   '2026-12-31 23:59:59'
         
        GROUP BY pcc.id
        )cc
        GROUP BY cc.business_id

select co.TENANT,co.TENANT_NAME,co.mall,co.mall_name,
        feeitem.name as fee_name,feeitem.code as fee_code,
        fee1.amount as now_amount,fee2.amount as last_amount,
        fee1.amount-fee2.amount as change_amount
        from
        erp_contract as co
        left join erp_sys_feeitems as feeitem on (1=1)
        left join (
        select sum(amount-amount_waiver) as amount,contractno, feecode from erp_sys_feebills
        where startdate >='2026-02-01 00:00:00' and enddate <='2026-02-28 00:00:00'
        group by contractno,feecode
        ) as fee1 on ( fee1.contractno= co.contractno and feeitem.code =fee1.feecode)
        left join (
        select sum(amount-amount_waiver) as amount ,contractno, feecode from erp_sys_feebills
        where startdate >='2025-02-01 00:00:00' and enddate <='2025-02-28 00:00:00'
        group by contractno,feecode
        ) as fee2 on ( fee2.contractno= co.contractno and feeitem.code =fee2.feecode)

        where 1=1 and (fee1.amount !=0 or  fee2.amount != 0)
           
             

        and co.mall in
         (  
            '101061'
         ) 
        group by co.contractno,feeitem.code LIMIT 50

select 
A.ContractsID,A.InvoiceID,A.ChargeTypeID,left(A.BizPeriod,7) AS BizPeriod,
sum(ifnull(A.InvNTRecAmtL,0))+sum(ifnull(B.InvNTRecAmtL,0)) as YSBHS, -- 应收不含税
sum(ifnull(A.InvRecAmtL,0)) as YS, -- 应收
sum(ifnull(B.InvRecAmtL,0)) AS TZ,  -- 调整
sum(ifnull(A.InvVerifyAmt,0))+sum(ifnull(B.InvVerifyAmt,0)) as SS
FROM (
SELECT 
Inv.ContractsID,
InvDet.InvoiceDetailID,
InvDet.InvoiceID,
InvDet.ChargeTypeID,
InvDet.BizPeriod,
sum(InvDet.InvVerifyAmt) as InvVerifyAmt,
SUM(InvDet.InvRecAmtL) as InvRecAmtL ,
SUM(InvDet.InvNTRecAmtL) AS InvNTRecAmtL
FROM TB_ODS_NEW_MI_INVOICE Inv INNER JOIN TB_ODS_NEW_MI_INVOICEDETAIL InvDet ON InvDet.InvoiceID = Inv.InvoiceID
AND IFNULL (InvDet.RInvoiceDetailID, '') = ''
WHERE Inv.InvoiceStatus <> 4 -- 去掉状态为取消
GROUP BY Inv.ContractsID,InvDet.InvoiceDetailID,InvDet.InvoiceID,InvDet.ChargeTypeID,InvDet.BizPeriod
) A LEFT JOIN (
SELECT 
Inv.ContractsID,
InvDet.RInvoiceDetailID,
InvDet.InvoiceID,
InvDet.ChargeTypeID,
InvDet.BizPeriod,
sum(InvDet.InvVerifyAmt) AS InvVerifyAmt,
SUM(InvDet.InvRecAmtL) AS InvRecAmtL,
SUM(InvDet.InvNTRecAmtL) AS InvNTRecAmtL
FROM TB_ODS_NEW_MI_INVOICE Inv INNER JOIN TB_ODS_NEW_MI_INVOICEDETAIL InvDet ON InvDet.InvoiceID = Inv.InvoiceID
WHERE Inv.InvoiceStatus <> 4 -- 去掉状态为取消
-- AND InvDet.InvType  in (2,3)
AND (InvDet.InvType  in (2,3) or (InvDet.InvType  = 1 and InvDet.RentType >= 10))   -- 增加租金公式为减免的账单负数
GROUP BY Inv.ContractsID,InvDet.RInvoiceDetailID,InvDet.InvoiceID,InvDet.ChargeTypeID,InvDet.BizPeriod
) B ON B.RInvoiceDetailID = A.InvoiceDetailID 
WHERE  
(A.InvRecAmtL<>0 or B.InvRecAmtL<>0 or A.InvVerifyAmt<>0) 
 
GROUP BY A.ContractsID,A.InvoiceID,A.ChargeTypeID,A.BizPeriod

SELECT
            DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(ccl.dialing_time), '%m-%d') AS timeSegment,
            COUNT(*) AS totalCalls,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ccl.dail_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredCalls,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ccl.dail_status = 1 AND ccl.ring_length BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredIn10s,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ccl.dail_status = 1 AND ccl.ring_length BETWEEN 1 AND 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredIn20s,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ccl.dail_status = 1 AND ccl.ring_length BETWEEN 1 AND 29 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredIn30s,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ccl.dail_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unansweredCalls
        FROM case_call_log ccl 
         
        LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = ccl.operator_id
         
        LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.id = su.dept_id
         
         
        WHERE ccl.is_del = 0
         AND ccl.dialing_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-02-04 00:00:00') 
         AND ccl.dialing_time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-02-10 23:59:59') 
         
         AND ccl.call_type = 1 
         
         
         
         
         
         AND (sd.id IN ( SELECT id FROM sys_dept WHERE id = 303 or find_in_set( 303 , ancestors ) ))
        GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(ccl.dialing_time), '%m-%d')
        ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(ccl.dialing_time), '%m-%d')

                WHEN t.product_type_id = 'textbook' THEN '资料产品'
                WHEN t.product_type_id = 'service' THEN '服务产品'
                ELSE '其他'
                END AS productType
             
        ,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) as value
        FROM (
        select
        sst.amount,
        tp.type as product_type_id,
        ps.course_type_id as course_type_id

        pc_class_times pct

        LEFT JOIN trade_order_item toi ON sst.trace_id = toi.trace_id

        LEFT JOIN bc_instructor_campus_ref ic

SELECT
        SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (1, 2, 3), 1, 0)) - SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (6, 7 ,8), 1, 0)) - sum(if(cc.consume_type=11 AND cc.src_consume_type IN(1,2,3) ,1,0)) as consumeSubjectNum,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.student_id) as consumeStudentNum,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.class_id, cc.times_num) as consumeTimesNum,
        SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (1, 2, 3), cc.class_consume_hour, 0)) - SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (6, 7 ,8), cc.class_consume_hour, 0)) - SUM(IF(cc.consume_type=11 AND cc.src_consume_type IN(1,2,3),cc.class_consume_hour, 0)) as classConsumeHour,
        SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8), cc.class_consume_amount, 0)) + COALESCE(sum(if(cc.consume_type=11 AND cc.src_consume_type IN(1,2,3) ,cc.class_consume_amount,null)),0) as classConsumeAmount
        FROM
        (SELECT
        pcc.consume_type,
        pcc.class_consume_hour,
        pcc.student_id,
        pcc.class_id,
        pcc.times_num,
        pcc.class_consume_amount,
        src.consume_type as src_consume_type
        FROM pc_class_consume pcc
        LEFT JOIN pc_class_consume src ON src.record_id = pcc.source_record_id
         
        INNER JOIN pc_class pc ON pcc.class_id = pc.id
        INNER JOIN pc_course ps ON pc.course_id = ps.id
        INNER JOIN trade_product tp ON pc.product_id = tp.id
        LEFT JOIN bc_business bu ON bu.id = pc.business_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_campus cp ON cp.id = pc.campus_id
        LEFT JOIN pc_course_system cs ON ps.course_system_id = cs.id
        LEFT JOIN bd_class_year cy ON cy.id = ps.class_year_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_class_semester css ON css.id = ps.class_semester_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_grade bg ON bg.id = ps.grade_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_subject bs ON bs.id = ps.subject_id
        
        LEFT JOIN pc_class_times sa ON pcc.class_id = sa.class_id and pcc.times_num = sa.num
        left join bd_class_type bct on bct.id = ps.class_type_id
        left join bd_course_series bdcs on ps.course_series_id=bdcs.id
        left join bd_course_type_item bcti on bcti.id=ps.course_type_item_id
     
        WHERE
         
        pcc.deleted = 0
        AND pcc.consume_type IN (1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 11)
         
            AND pc.business_id IN
             (  
                4
             ) 
         
         
         
            AND tp.type = 'course'
         
         
            AND ps.course_type_id = 3
         
         
         
     
         
         
     
         
         
     
         
         
     
         
         
     
         
         
            and pcc.create_time >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
         
         
            and pcc.create_time   <=   '2026-12-31 23:59:59'
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
      GROUP BY pcc.id)cc

select a.pro_code
, b. QJ as end_qj
, (a.QJ - b. QJ) as last_ql
, case when ifnull(a. QJ,0) = 0  then 0 else (a.QJ - b. QJ)/a. QJ  end as lsat_qlv
, (c.QJ - b. QJ) as ljql
,a.QJ 开始
,b.QJ 结束
from ( 
-- 开始日的欠缴金额
select 
pro_code,
SUM(QJ) AS QJ  from (
select pro_code,
sum(YS)/10000 as YS,
sum(TZ)/10000 as TZ,
sum(SS)/10000 AS SS,
sum(YS+TZ-SS)/10000 AS QJ
from TB_DM_ARREARS_KUAIZHAO
where 1=1
AND FileDate = '2025-01-01'
and pro_code in ('60058')
and ChargeTypename in ('1','2','3','4')
and PRO_DATE >='2025-01'
and PRO_DATE <='2025-12'
group by pro_code
) p GROUP BY pro_code ) a
left join 
-- 结束日的欠缴金额
(select 
pro_code,
SUM(QJ) AS QJ  from (
select pro_code,
sum(YS)/10000 as YS,
sum(TZ)/10000 as TZ,
sum(SS)/10000 AS SS,
sum(YS)/10000+sum(TZ)/10000-sum(SS)/10000 AS QJ
from TB_DM_ARREARS_KUAIZHAO
where FileDate = '2025-12-31'
and pro_code in ('60058')
and ChargeTypename in ('1','2','3','4')
and PRO_DATE >='2025-01'
and PRO_DATE <='2025-12'
group by pro_code
) p GROUP BY pro_code ) b
on a.pro_code=b.pro_code
left join 
-- 累计日欠缴欠缴金额
(select 
pro_code,
SUM(QJ) AS QJ  from (
select pro_code,
sum(YS)/10000 as YS,
sum(TZ)/10000 as TZ,
sum(SS)/10000 AS SS,
sum(YS)/10000+sum(TZ)/10000-sum(SS)/10000 AS QJ
from TB_DM_ARREARS_KUAIZHAO
where FileDate = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
and pro_code in ('60058')
and ChargeTypename in ('1','2','3','4')
and PRO_DATE >='2025-01'
and PRO_DATE <='2025-12'
group by pro_code
) p GROUP BY pro_code ) c
on a.pro_code=c.pro_code

SELECT dates as refundDate,MAX(payActualTotal) as payActualTotal,MAX(refundCount) as refundCount,MAX(payActualTotalScore) as payActualTotalScore FROM(
        SELECT @cdate := DATE_ADD(@cdate,INTERVAL - 1 DAY) dates ,0 AS payActualTotal,0 AS 'refundCount',0 as 'payActualTotalScore'
        FROM (SELECT @cdate :=DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL + 1 DAY) FROM tz_user) t1
         WHERE  @cdate >= '2026-01-23 23:59:59.999' 
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dates,SUM(refund_amount) AS payActualTotal,COUNT(refund_id) refundCount,
        sum(tor.refund_score) as payActualTotalScore
        FROM  tz_order_refund tor
         WHERE  shop_id = 1
            
            
                and refund_time >= '2026-01-23 23:59:59.999'
            
            
                and refund_time <= '2026-02-23 23:59:59.999'
            
            AND return_money_sts =5 
        GROUP BY dates)_tmpAllTable  GROUP BY dates
        ORDER BY dates

SELECT dates, MAX(orderCount) AS payOrderCount,MAX(payActualTotal) as payActualTotal,MAX(payActualTotalScore) as payActualTotalScore FROM(
        SELECT @cdate := DATE_ADD(@cdate,INTERVAL - 1 DAY) dates ,0 AS 'orderCount',0 AS 'payActualTotal',0 as 'payActualTotalScore'
        FROM (SELECT @cdate :=DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL + 1 DAY) FROM tz_user) t1
         WHERE  @cdate >= '2026-01-27 23:59:59.999' 
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dates,COUNT(*) AS orderCount,
            SUM(actual_total) AS payActualTotal,
            SUM(ifnull(o.actual_total_score,0)) AS payActualTotalScore
        FROM tz_order o
         WHERE  o.shop_id = 1
            
            
                and o.pay_time >= '2026-01-27 23:59:59.999'
            
            
                and o.pay_time <= '2026-02-27 23:59:59.999'
            
            AND o.is_payed =1 
        GROUP BY dates) _tmpAllTable  GROUP BY dates
        ORDER BY dates

select * from (
SELECT *
FROM (
			SELECT A.PRO_CODE -- 项目编码
						,A.CONTRACTSID -- 合同编号
						,B.CONTRACTSID AS LAST_CONTRACTSID
						,A.RentArea -- 租赁面积
						,A.CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
						,B.ConStopDate -- 合同提前终止时间
						,A.ModifyTime
						,A.UnitTypeCode
						,A.UNITID
						,A.BrandID
						,A.BrandName
						,A.TradeRelationName1
            ,'2025-11' AS FileDate
						,TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE ) AS DIFF -- 日期相差天数
						-- 如果相差天数>=1 或者没有上一份合同的话就判断为新引
						-- 如果相差天数<0 也就是说上一份合同合同还没有到结束时间 新合同就开始了
						,CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE) > 1 THEN '新引'
									WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE) IS NULL THEN '新引'
									ELSE '汰换' END LABLE
			FROM (

						SELECT CONTRACTSID -- 合同id
									,PRO_CODE
									,RentArea
									,UNITID -- 铺位id
									,UnitTypeCode
									,BrandID
									,BrandName
									,TradeRelationName1
									,CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
									,CONENDDATE -- 合同结束时间
									,ModifyTime
						FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO
						WHERE BIZMODE = 1 -- 筛选铺位类型为租赁
									-- AND CONTRACTSSTATUS = 3 -- 筛选合同状态为进行中
									AND CONTRACTSSTATUS not in (1,2,10)
									and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2025-11','-01'),interval 1 month),7)
						) A
				
						LEFT JOIN 
						
						(
			-- 筛选每个项目除现正在执行中的合同,然后查出每个铺位最早开始的合同
			SELECT CONTRACTSID -- 合同id
						,UNITID -- 铺位id
						,CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
						,CONENDDATE -- 合同结束时间
						,MAX(ConStopDate) ConStopDate-- 合同提前结束时间
			FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO A
			WHERE BIZMODE = 1 -- 晒选铺位类型为租赁
						AND CONTRACTSSTATUS != 3 -- 筛选合同状态不为进行中
						and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2025-11','-01'),interval 1 month),7)
						AND 1 = (SELECT COUNT(1) -- 筛选最大开始时间的合同
										 FROM (SELECT CONTRACTSID
																	,UNITID
																	,ConStartDate
																	,CONENDDATE
																	,CONTRACTSSTATUS
														FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO
														WHERE BIZMODE = 1
																	AND CONTRACTSSTATUS NOT IN (1,2,10)
																	AND CONTRACTSSTATUS != 3 -- 筛选合同状态不为进行中
																	and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2025-11','-01'),interval 1 month),7)	) B 
											WHERE A.UNITID = B.UNITID AND A.ConStartDate <= B.ConStartDate)
			GROUP BY UNITID 
						) B ON A.UNITID = B.UNITID
WHERE 1=1

)A
WHERE CONTRACTSID in (
-- 新签合同信息
SELECT ContractsID FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_SIGN WHERE FileDate = '2025-11'

select

SELECT

    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.id)
        FROM case_enforce ce
        LEFT JOIN case_bind_tag cbt ON cbt.case_id = ce.id 
             AND cbt.tag_id IN (35, 77, 101) AND cbt.is_del = 0
             AND cbt.create_date >= MAKEDATE(@year, 1)
             AND cbt.create_date < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(@year, 1), INTERVAL m.month_num MONTH)
        WHERE ce.is_del = 0 
          AND ce.media_no_self != ''
          AND (
              (ce.media_status = 300 
               AND ce.settle_time >= MAKEDATE(@year, 1) 
               AND ce.settle_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(@year, 1), INTERVAL m.month_num MONTH))
              OR cbt.id IS NOT NULL
          )
    ) AS success_count_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
    UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 
    UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12
) m
ORDER BY m.month_num

SELECT *
FROM (
			SELECT A.PRO_CODE -- 项目编码
						,A.CONTRACTSID -- 合同编号
						,B.CONTRACTSID AS LAST_CONTRACTSID
						,A.RentArea -- 租赁面积
						,A.CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
						,B.ConStopDate -- 合同提前终止时间
						,A.ModifyTime
						,A.UnitTypeCode
						,A.UNITID
						,A.BrandID
						,A.BrandName
						,A.TradeRelationName1
            ,'2026-01' AS FileDate
						,TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE ) AS DIFF -- 日期相差天数
						-- 如果相差天数>=1 或者没有上一份合同的话就判断为新引
						-- 如果相差天数<0 也就是说上一份合同合同还没有到结束时间 新合同就开始了
						,CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE) > 1 THEN '新引'
									WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE) IS NULL THEN '新引'
									ELSE '汰换' END LABLE
			FROM (

						SELECT CONTRACTSID -- 合同id
									,PRO_CODE
									,RentArea
									,UNITID -- 铺位id
									,UnitTypeCode
									,BrandID
									,BrandName
									,TradeRelationName1
									,CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
									,CONENDDATE -- 合同结束时间
									,ModifyTime
						FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO
						WHERE BIZMODE = 1 -- 筛选铺位类型为租赁
									-- AND CONTRACTSSTATUS = 3 -- 筛选合同状态为进行中
									AND CONTRACTSSTATUS not in (1,2,10)
									and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2026-01','-01'),interval 1 month),7)
						) A
				
						LEFT JOIN 
						
						(
			-- 筛选每个项目除现正在执行中的合同,然后查出每个铺位最早开始的合同
			SELECT CONTRACTSID -- 合同id
						,UNITID -- 铺位id
						,CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
						,CONENDDATE -- 合同结束时间
						,MAX(ConStopDate) ConStopDate-- 合同提前结束时间
			FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO A
			WHERE BIZMODE = 1 -- 晒选铺位类型为租赁
						AND CONTRACTSSTATUS != 3 -- 筛选合同状态不为进行中
						and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2026-01','-01'),interval 1 month),7)
						AND 1 = (SELECT COUNT(1) -- 筛选最大开始时间的合同
										 FROM (SELECT CONTRACTSID
																	,UNITID
																	,ConStartDate
																	,CONENDDATE
																	,CONTRACTSSTATUS
														FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO
														WHERE BIZMODE = 1
																	AND CONTRACTSSTATUS NOT IN (1,2,10)
																	AND CONTRACTSSTATUS != 3 -- 筛选合同状态不为进行中
																	and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2026-01','-01'),interval 1 month),7)	) B 
											WHERE A.UNITID = B.UNITID AND A.ConStartDate <= B.ConStartDate)
			GROUP BY UNITID 
						) B ON A.UNITID = B.UNITID
WHERE 1=1

)A
WHERE CONTRACTSID in (
-- 新签合同信息
SELECT ContractsID FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_SIGN WHERE FileDate = '2026-01'
)

select count(*) as total from (select                                    `index_机构名称_1`  ,                     `index_案件总数_1`  ,                     `index_成功数量_1`  ,                     `index_可联数量_1`  ,                     `index_标的总额_1`  ,                     `index_成功标的_1`             from(select    `机构名称` as `index_机构名称_1`,`案件总数` as `index_案件总数_1`,`成功数量` as `index_成功数量_1`,`可联数量` as `index_可联数量_1`,`标的总额` as `index_标的总额_1`,`成功标的` as `index_成功标的_1`  from (SELECT `机构名称` AS `机构名称`,`案件总数` AS `案件总数`,`成功数量` AS `成功数量`,`可联数量` AS `可联数量`,`标的总额` AS `标的总额`,`成功标的` AS `成功标的` FROM (SELECT `机构名称` AS `机构名称`,`案件总数` AS `案件总数`,`成功数量` AS `成功数量`,`可联数量` AS `可联数量`,`标的总额` AS `标的总额`,`成功标的` AS `成功标的` FROM (SELECT u.real_name AS `机构名称`, b.案件总数, b.标的总额, b.成功数量, b.可联数量
	, b.成功标的
FROM (
	SELECT a.plaintiff_id, COUNT(*) AS "案件总数", SUM(a.case_amt) AS "标的总额"
		, SUM(a.is_success_in_range) AS "成功数量"
		, SUM(CASE
			WHEN a.long_contact_rst = 10 THEN 1
			ELSE 0
		END) AS "可联数量"
		, SUM(CASE
			WHEN a.is_success_in_range = 1 THEN a.case_amt
			ELSE 0
		END) AS "成功标的"
	FROM (
		SELECT ce.id, ce.plaintiff_id, ce.case_amt, ce.long_contact_rst
			, MAX(CASE
				WHEN cbt.tag_id IN (35, 77, 101)
					AND cbt.create_date >= '2025-02-01 16:11:53'
					AND cbt.create_date < '2026-02-28 23:59:53'
				THEN 1
				WHEN ce.media_status = 300
					AND ce.settle_time >= '2025-02-01 16:11:53'
					AND ce.settle_time < '2026-02-28 23:59:53'
				THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END) AS is_success_in_range
		FROM case_enforce ce
			LEFT JOIN case_bind_tag cbt
			ON cbt.case_id = ce.id
				AND cbt.tag_id IN (35, 77, 101)
				AND cbt.is_del = 0
		WHERE ce.is_del = 0
			AND ce.`status` >= 100
			AND ce.media_no_self != ''
			AND ce.create_date > '2025-03-01'
			AND ce.register_date > '2025-01-01 16:12:02'
			AND ce.register_date < '2026-02-28 23:12:12'
			AND 1 = 1
			AND 1 = 1
		GROUP BY ce.id
	) a
	GROUP BY a.plaintiff_id
) b

	 ,CASE WHEN D.UnitPrice_TQM - B.UnitPrice_TQ > 0 THEN 1 END 同期租金加营运

	group by ContractsID

SELECT store_total.*
        ,CONCAT(
        '[',
        GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT
        JSON_OBJECT(
        CONCAT('1',month_total.salesDate,'销售累计'),
        month_total.salesAmount,
        CONCAT('2',month_total.salesDate,'销售指标'),
        month_total.salesPlan,
        CONCAT('3',month_total.salesDate,'指标完成率'),
        IF(month_total.salesPlan = 0 , 100, TRUNCATE((month_total.salesAmount/month_total.salesPlan)*100,2))
        )),
        ']'
        )  AS monthTotal
        ,CONCAT(
        '[',
        GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT
        JSON_OBJECT(
        CONCAT('1',year_total.salesDate,'销售累计'),
        year_total.salesAmount,
        CONCAT('2',year_total.salesDate,'销售指标'),
        year_total.salesPlan,
        CONCAT('3',year_total.salesDate,'指标完成率'),
        IF(year_total.salesPlan = 0 , 100, TRUNCATE((year_total.salesAmount/year_total.salesPlan)*100,2))
        )),
        ']'
        )  AS yearTotal
        FROM (
        SELECT
        a.store_id AS storeId,
        a.store_name AS storeName,
        SUM( a.sales_amount ) AS salesAmount,
        b.lastAmount,
        TRUNCATE((SUM( a.sales_amount ) - b.lastAmount)/b.lastAmount*100,2) AS yoyRate
        FROM
        sales_goods_report a
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT sgr.store_id,SUM( sales_amount ) AS lastAmount FROM sales_goods_report sgr WHERE
        sgr.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= DATE_SUB('2026-02-01',INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_SUB('2026-02-28',INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY sgr.store_id) b ON b.store_id = a.store_id
        WHERE
        a.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( a.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= '2026-02-01'
        AND DATE_FORMAT( a.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= '2026-02-28'
         
        GROUP BY a.store_id) store_total
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sgr.store_id,
        DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y年%m月' ) AS salesDate,
        SUM( sgr.sales_amount ) AS salesAmount,
        IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SALES) FROM jpaas_erp.erp_plan_floor pf WHERE pf.MALL = sgr.store_id AND pf.YEARMONTH = DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y%m' )),0) AS salesPlan
        FROM
        sales_goods_report sgr
        WHERE
        sgr.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m' ) >= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-01' ,'%Y-%m')
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m' ) <= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-28' ,'%Y-%m')
        GROUP BY sgr.store_id,DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time,'%Y-%m' )) month_total ON month_total.store_id = store_total.storeId
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sgr.store_id,
        DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y年' ) AS salesDate,
        SUM( sgr.sales_amount ) AS salesAmount,
        IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SALES) FROM jpaas_erp.erp_plan_floor pf WHERE pf.MALL = sgr.store_id AND pf.YEARMONTH = DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y%m' )),0) AS salesPlan
        FROM
        sales_goods_report sgr
        WHERE
        sgr.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y' ) >= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-01' ,'%Y')
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y' ) <= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-28' ,'%Y')
        GROUP BY sgr.store_id,DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time,'%Y' )) year_total ON year_total.store_id = store_total.storeId
        GROUP BY store_total.storeId

select avg(租售比) 平均租售比 from(
select * from(
SELECT 
A.PRO_CODE,SUM(A.面积) AS 面积, SUM(B.租金收入) AS 租金收入,SUM(C.销售额) AS 销售额,
CASE 
WHEN IFNULL(SUM(C.销售额),0) = 0 OR IFNULL(SUM(B.租金收入) ,0) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE SUM(B.租金收入) /SUM(C.销售额) END AS 租售比 
FROM (

ContractsID AS 合同ID,Pro_Code,
BrandID AS 品牌ID,

AND '2026-01' <= LEFT(ConStopDate,7) 
AND (ChargeStartDate  !=  CONCAT('2026-01','-01') AND ConStopDate != '2026-01-31')
AND TradeRelationName1 IN ('零售','餐饮','儿童','娱乐体验','健康&生活')

) A LEFT JOIN (

)B ON A.合同ID=B.合同ID
LEFT JOIN (

,SUM(PAIDAMT) AS 销售额 -- 销售额

SELECT ContractsID

				SELECT ContractsID
										,UNITID
										,ChargeTypeID
										,MAX(UsableArea) RentArea
										,SUM(FirstValue*UsableArea) price
							FROM (
							
							
				#以下是基准价面积等等字段sql过程
										SELECT  A.ContractsCode -- 租约号
													 ,A.UNITID -- 铺位id
													 ,A.RENTSTANDARDYEAR -- 年度
													 ,A.UsableArea -- 面积
													 ,A.FIRSTVALUE -- 基准价
													 ,A.BizMode -- 类型
													 ,CASE WHEN A.RentStandardItemID = 'fea18352-3379-4990-ab25-4469cb1a5e1c' THEN 4
																 WHEN A.RentStandardItemID = '858bd22e-8728-4781-831e-6c8a3f4a10b6' THEN 3 END RentStandardItemID -- 每周前四后三天
												   ,ChargeTypeID
													 ,A.ContractsID
										FROM (-- 基准价表筛选有效的后关联基准价总表并且显示面积
													SELECT B.ContractsCode -- 租约号
																,B.UNITID -- 铺位id
																,D.RENTSTANDARDYEAR
																,B.UsableArea
																,D.FIRSTVALUE
																,B.BizMode
																,D.RentStandardItemID
																,ChargeTypeID	
																,B.ContractsID
													FROM (-- 筛选项目编号、生效合同、bizmode=1的合同信息
																SELECT ContractsCode 
																			,UNITID
																			,UsableArea
																			,BizMode
																			,ContractsID
																FROM TB_DW_NEW_UNIT_CONTRACT 
																		 -- 铺位合同表
																WHERE PRO_CODE IN ('60002','60004','60005','60008','60009','60011','60015','60016','60017','60018','60020','60024','60029','60030','60034','60036','60037','60041','60053','60058','60071','60072','60075','60078','60080')	  
																			AND ContractsID IN 	(SELECT ContractsID
																													 FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONFORMULA
																													)
																		  AND left(ConStopDate,10) >= '2026-01-01' 
																					and left(ChargeStartDate,10) <= '2026-02-23'
																			AND BizMode = 1 ) B
																			
															 INNER JOIN 
															 
															 (
															 SELECT D.RentStandardID
																		 ,D.RentStandardYear
																		 ,D.RentStandardItemID
																		 ,D.FirstValue
																		 ,D.UnitID
																		 ,D.ChargeTypeID
															 FROM (SELECT  A.RentStandardID
																						,A.RentStandardYear
																						,B.RentStandardItemID
																						,B.FirstValue
																						,B.UnitID
																						,B.ChargeTypeID
																			FROM TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARD A -- 基准价主表 left join 基准价明细表
																					 LEFT JOIN TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARDDETAIL B ON A.RentStandardID = B.RentStandardID
																			WHERE RentStandardStatus = 1 -- 筛选有效
																						-- 筛选费用类型
																						AND ChargeTypeID in ('214','17f43055-3816-4983-9dd0-cbe3eb4a6d6a','101','226','afc0b818-4ab5-4aee-b642-1e8a8c3828f9') ) D  INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(RentStandardYear) RentStandardYear
																																																					,UnitID
																																																		FROM TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARD A
																																																				 LEFT JOIN TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARDDETAIL B ON  A.RentStandardID = B.RentStandardID
																																																		WHERE RentStandardStatus = 1 -- 筛选有效
																																																					AND ChargeTypeID in ('214','17f43055-3816-4983-9dd0-cbe3eb4a6d6a','101','226','afc0b818-4ab5-4aee-b642-1e8a8c3828f9') -- 筛选费用类型
																																																		GROUP BY UnitID) E ON D.UnitID = E.UnitID AND D.RENTSTANDARDYEAR = E.RentStandardYear 
															) D ON B.UNITID = D.UNITID
													 ) A
				#以上是基准价面积等等字段sql	
										) AA
							
							GROUP BY ContractsID ,UNITID
							) AA

GROUP BY ContractsID

CASE 
WHEN 租售比 < YJ_VALUE THEN '1'
WHEN 租售比 >= YJ_VALUE and 租售比 < GJ_VALUE THEN '0'
ELSE '-1' END AS 状态
FROM (
SELECT 
A.合同ID,A.品牌ID, A.品牌名称, A.一级业态,A.三级业态, SUM(A.面积) AS 面积, SUM(B.租金收入) AS 租金收入,SUM(C.销售额) AS 销售额,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(C.销售额),0) = 0 OR IFNULL(SUM(B.租金收入) ,0) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE SUM(B.租金收入) /SUM(C.销售额) END AS 租售比 
FROM (
-- 合同信息
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID,
BrandID AS 品牌ID,
BrandName AS 品牌名称,
TradeRelationName1 AS 一级业态,
TradeRelationName3 AS 三级业态,
RentArea AS 面积
FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS
WHERE Pro_Code in ('60002')
and BizMode=1 -- 取租赁
-- and ContractsStatus in (3) -- 合同状态为进行中
-- 合同有效期包含在所选月且合同开始日非所选月首日/合同结束日非所选月最后一日的
AND '2026-02' >= LEFT(ChargeStartDate,7)  -- 
AND '2026-02' <= LEFT(ConStopDate,7) 
AND (ChargeStartDate  !=  CONCAT('2026-02','-01') AND ConStopDate != '2026-02-28')
AND TradeRelationName1 IN ('零售','餐饮','儿童','娱乐体验','健康&生活')
AND  ContractsStatus != 10
) A LEFT JOIN (
-- 租金收入
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID
,SUM(YS+TZ) AS 租金收入
FROM TB_DW_NEW_ARREARS_CENTER_CC
WHERE BizPeriod = '2026-02' 
AND ChargeTypeID IN ('214','215','230','101','226') -- 费项（固定租金、抽成租金、年度抽成，营运管理费、营运管理费（C））
AND PRO_CODE= '60002'
GROUP BY ContractsID
)B ON A.合同ID=B.合同ID
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID
,SUM(PAIDAMT) AS 销售额 -- 销售额
FROM TB_DW_NEW_PRO_MARKET
WHERE 1=1
AND PRO_DATE >= CONCAT('2026-02','-01')
AND PRO_DATE <= '2026-02-28'
AND PRO_CODE IN ('60002')
GROUP BY ContractsID
)C ON A.合同ID=C.合同ID
GROUP BY A.合同ID,A.品牌ID, A.品牌名称, A.一级业态,A.三级业态
)P -- 关联租售比预警值
LEFT JOIN TB_FILL_MOBILE_ZSB ZSB 
ON P.三级业态=ZSB.COMMERCIAL_FORM
)A 
ORDER BY 租售比 DESC

select a.项目名称,a.合同ID,b.YS as 其他费用,c.YS as 抽成租金 from (
-- 合同信息
select 
distinct 
Pro_Code as 项目名称,
ContractsID as 合同ID
from TB_DW_NEW_UNIT_CONTRACT 
where 
left(ConStopDate,10) >= '2026-01-01' 
and left(ChargeStartDate,10) <= '2026-01-31'
-- 本期期间生效过的合同（一天生效也算）
and Pro_Code in ('60002','60004','60005','60008','60011','60016','60017','60018','60020','60024','60029','60030','60034','60036','60037','60053','60058','60071','60072','60075','60078','60080')
and UnitTypeCode in ('149','148','147','123','145')
			   and (ContractsStatus in (3,4,5,6,7,8) 
			   or (ContractsStatus in (10) and TransferOutDate >= '2026-01-31' )) -- 优化合同状态范围
) a left join (
-- 本月固定租金；营运管理费; 营运管理费(C);
select b.pro_code,a.ContractsID,sum(a.YS ) as YS
from TB_DW_NEW_ARREARS_CENTER  a left join
TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS b on a.ContractsID=b.ContractsID
where a.ChargeTypeID in  ('214','17f43055-3816-4983-9dd0-cbe3eb4a6d6a','101','226','afc0b818-4ab5-4aee-b642-1e8a8c3828f9')
-- 214 固定租金；101 营运管理费; 226 营运管理费(C);
and left(a.BizPeriod,7) = '2026-01' 
and b.pro_code in ('60002','60004','60005','60008','60011','60016','60017','60018','60020','60024','60029','60030','60034','60036','60037','60053','60058','60071','60072','60075','60078','60080')
group by b.pro_code,a.ContractsID
) b on a.合同ID = b.ContractsID and a.项目名称 = b.pro_code
left join (
-- 上月抽成租金
select b.pro_code,a.ContractsID,sum(a.YS) as YS
from TB_DW_NEW_ARREARS_CENTER  a left join
TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS b on a.ContractsID=b.ContractsID
where a.ChargeTypeID in  ('215')
-- 215 抽成租金
and left(a.BizPeriod,7) = '2025-12' 
and b.pro_code in ('60002','60004','60005','60008','60011','60016','60017','60018','60020','60024','60029','60030','60034','60036','60037','60053','60058','60071','60072','60075','60078','60080')
group by b.pro_code,a.ContractsID
) c on a.合同ID = c.ContractsID and a.项目名称 = c.pro_code

        srp.pay_lists,
        srg.good_lists,
        sr.vip_card_id as cardid,
        sr.vip_mobile as mobile,
        sr.point_ as point,
        PER.SHOPNO as dept_code,PER.SHOPID as shopid,PER.SHOPNO_NAME as dept_name,
        PER.NAME as name_,
        case sr.type_
         when 0 then '销售'
         when 1 then '负销售'
         when 2 then '退货'
         when 3 then '补录'
         when 4 then '销售上报'
        end as source,
        PER.NAME as payname,
        PER.SHOP_NAME as store_name,
        PER.SHOP as shop,
        ifnull(srp.amount,0)+ifnull(srgd.disc_amount,0) as amount,
        ifnull(srp.amount,0) as cash_amount,
        concat(sr.pos_no,sr.rec_id) order_id,
        ifnull(srgd.disc_amount,0) as disamount,
        payl.extra_ as extra,
        pos.PAYFREE_TERMINAL_NO as PAYFREE_TERMINAL_NO,
        srg.contractno as contractno
        from pos_sale_rec sr
        LEFT JOIN erp_sys_pos as pos on sr.pos_no =pos.POSNO
        LEFT JOIN
        (select a.rec_id,a.pos_no,sum(a.amount) amount,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pt.name) pay_lists

        from pos_sale_rec_pay as a
        LEFT JOIN erp_sys_paytype as pt ON pt.id_=a.payment_id
        GROUP BY a.rec_id,a.pos_no) as srp on srp.rec_id=sr.rec_id and srp.pos_no=sr.pos_no
        LEFT JOIN
        (select b.rec_id,b.pos_no,sum(b.disc_amount) as disc_amount FROM pos_sale_rec_good_disc as b GROUP BY
        b.rec_id,b.pos_no) as srgd
        on srgd.rec_id=sr.rec_id and srgd.pos_no=sr.pos_no
        LEFT JOIN erp_person_def PER ON(SR.CASHIER_ID =PER.id_)
        left join erp_contract as contract on  (PER.SHOPNO=contract.CONTRACTNO)
        LEFT JOIN
        (select srgt.rec_id,srgt.pos_no,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT gt.NAME) good_lists,gt.contractno contractno
        from pos_sale_rec_good as srgt
        LEFT JOIN erp_sys_goods as gt on srgt.good_id=gt.id_
        GROUP BY srgt.rec_id,srgt.pos_no) as srg on srg.rec_id=sr.rec_id and srg.pos_no=sr.pos_no

	IFNULL(A.B.paid_amount_TCJF,  0) AS paid_amount_TCJF,
	A.created_at 
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		A.mall_bi_id,
		A.mall_id,
		B.PRO_INFO,
		B.PRO_AREA,
		A.paid_amount_BH,
		A.paid_amount_CS,
		A.paid_amount_QT,
		A.paid_amount_YY,
		A.created_at 
	FROM
		(
		SELECT
			A.mall_id,
			B.mall_bi_id,
			A.paid_amount_BH,
			A.paid_amount_CS,
			A.paid_amount_QT,
			A.paid_amount_YY,
			A.created_at 
		FROM
			(
			SELECT
				A.mall_id,
				A.created_at,
				A.paid_amount_BH,
				A.paid_amount_CS,
				A.paid_amount_YY,
				B.paid_amount_QT 
			FROM
				(
				SELECT
					A.mall_id,
					A.created_at,
					A.paid_amount_BH,
					A.paid_amount_CS,
					B.paid_amount_YY 
				FROM
					(
					SELECT
						A.mall_id,
						A.created_at,
						A.paid_amount_BH,
						B.paid_amount_CS 
					FROM
						(
						SELECT
							A.mall_id,
							A.created_at,
							B.paid_amount_BH 
						FROM
							( SELECT DISTINCT mall_id, SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) AS created_at FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDERS 
							WHERE created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
              AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')) A -- 获取完整的时间维度
							LEFT JOIN (
							SELECT
								mall_id,
								SUM( paid_amount ) AS paid_amount_BH,
								SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) AS created_at 
							FROM
								TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDERS 
							WHERE
								type <> 7 -- 不含停车缴费
                                AND type <> 2 -- 不含积分订单
								AND id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDER_DETAIL WHERE `status` IN (16,17,18)) -- 在订单明细表中订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
								AND `status` NOT IN (16,17,18) -- 订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
								AND shop_id IN ( SELECT id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_BHG_SYNC_SHOPS WHERE third_id LIKE '%-%' ) -- 关联赢商合同表中的租约号 且租约号含有‘-’ 为百货
						    AND created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
                AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')
						GROUP BY
								mall_id,
								SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) 
							) B ON  A.mall_id = B.mall_id AND A.created_at = B.created_at 
						) A
						LEFT JOIN (
						SELECT
							mall_id,
							SUM( paid_amount ) AS paid_amount_CS,
							SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) AS created_at 
						FROM
							TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDERS 
						WHERE
							type <> 7 -- 不含停车缴费
                            AND type <> 2 -- 不含积分订单
							AND id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDER_DETAIL WHERE `status` IN (16,17,18)) -- 在订单明细表中订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
							AND `status` NOT IN (16,17,18) -- 订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
							AND shop_id IN ( SELECT id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_BHG_SYNC_SHOPS WHERE industry_name_2 = '超市' ) -- 关联赢商合同表中的业态 且业态为‘超市’ 则判断为超市
							AND created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
              AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')
						GROUP BY
							mall_id,
							SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) 
						) B ON A.mall_id = B.mall_id 
						AND A.created_at = B.created_at 
					) A
					LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT
						mall_id,
						SUM( paid_amount ) AS paid_amount_YY,
						SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) AS created_at 
					FROM
						TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDERS 
					WHERE
							type <> 7 -- 不含停车缴费
                            AND type <> 2 -- 不含积分订单
							AND id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDER_DETAIL WHERE `status` IN (16,17,18)) -- 在订单明细表中订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
							AND `status` NOT IN (16,17,18) -- 订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
						  AND shop_id IN ( SELECT id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_BHG_SYNC_SHOPS WHERE industry_name_2 = '影院' ) -- 关联赢商合同表中的业态 且业态为‘影院’ 则判断为影院
              AND created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
              AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')
					GROUP BY
						mall_id,
						SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) 
					) B ON A.mall_id = B.mall_id 
					AND A.created_at = B.created_at 
				) A
				LEFT JOIN (
				SELECT
					mall_id,
					SUM( paid_amount ) AS paid_amount_QT,
					SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) AS created_at 
				FROM
					TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDERS 
				WHERE
					type <> 7 -- 不含停车缴费
                    AND type <> 2 -- 不含积分订单
					AND id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDER_DETAIL WHERE `status` IN (16,17,18)) -- 在订单明细表中订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
					AND `status` NOT IN (16,17,18) -- 订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
					AND shop_id NOT IN ( SELECT id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_BHG_SYNC_SHOPS WHERE industry_name_2 = '超市' OR industry_name_2 = '影院' OR third_id LIKE '%-%' ) 
                    -- 关联赢商合同表中的业态 且业态不为‘影院’，‘超市’， 并不含 ‘-’  则判断为其他，及购物中心销售额
          AND created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
          AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')
				GROUP BY
					mall_id,
					SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) 
				) B ON B.mall_id = A.mall_id 
				AND B.created_at = A.created_at 
			) A
			LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mall_id, mall_bi_id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_MALL_MAP ) B ON A.mall_id = B.mall_id -- 关联维度表获取bi_id
		) A
		LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRO_INFO, PRO_AREA, PRO_CODE FROM TB_DIM_PROJECT ) B ON A.mall_bi_id = B.PRO_CODE -- 获取项目名称及地区
	) A
	LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		mall_id,
		SUM( paid_amount ) AS paid_amount_TCJF,
		SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) AS created_at 
	FROM
		TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDERS 
	WHERE
		type = 7 -- 消费类型为停车缴费
		AND id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDER_DETAIL WHERE `status` IN (16,17,18)) -- 在订单明细表中订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
		AND `status` NOT IN (16,17,18) -- 订单类型不属于 16:待支付 17:购买失败 18:关闭
		AND created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
    AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')
	GROUP BY
		mall_id,
		SUBSTR( created_at, 1, 10 ) 
	) B ON A.mall_id = B.mall_id 
	AND A.created_at = B.created_at
    ORDER BY
	A.created_at DESC

select  tab.*,tab.business_id from (
	select
		'2026-02' AS yearMonth,
			t.*,
		 ( SELECT bu.`NAME` FROM bc_business bu WHERE bu.id = t.business_id ) AS business_name,
		sa.`name` AS teacher_name,
		sa.job_no,
	  	sum(t.dueComeNum) as should_person_num,
	  	sum(t.hadComeNum) as alreadyPersonNum ,
	  	sum(t.notComeNum) as notPersonNum ,
	 
	  	sum(t.overtimeNum) as timeoutPersonNum ,
	  	sum(t.arrivedOvertimeNum) as totalPersonNum ,
	  	sum(t.nonArrivedOvertimeNum) as totalnotPersonNum ,
	 		
		sum(t.dueComeNum * t.single_class_hour)  AS should_classhour,
		sum(t.hadComeNum * t.single_class_hour)  AS already_classhour,
		sum(t.notComeNum * t.single_class_hour)  AS not_classhour,
	
		sum(t.overtimeNum * t.single_class_hour)  AS timeout_classhour,
		sum(t.arrivedOvertimeNum * t.single_class_hour) AS totalAlreadyClasshour,
		sum(t.nonArrivedOvertimeNum * t.single_class_hour) AS totalNotClasshour,
	
		sum(t.dueComeNum * t.single_class_hour * t.class_hour_duration)/60 AS totalShouldDuration,
		sum(t.hadComeNum * t.single_class_hour * t.class_hour_duration)/60 AS totalAlreadyDuration,
		sum(t.notComeNum * t.single_class_hour * t.class_hour_duration)/60 AS totalNotDuration,
	
		SUM( t.gudinN) AS gudinNum,
		SUM( t.tiaoruN) AS tiaoruNum,
		SUM( t.bukeN) AS bukeNum,
			
		sum(t.overtimeNum * t.single_class_hour  * t.class_hour_duration)/60 AS timeoutClass,
		sum(t.arrivedOvertimeNum * t.single_class_hour*t.class_hour_duration)/60 AS totalAlready,
		sum(t.nonArrivedOvertimeNum * t.single_class_hour*t.class_hour_duration)/60 AS totalNot ,
		
		sum(t.twoToOneNum)	AS twoToOne,
		sum(t.twoToZeroNum) AS twoToZero,
		sum(t.oneToZeroNum) AS oneToZero,
		sum(t.zeroToOneNum) AS zeroToOne,
		
		sum(t.nonArrivedGudinN) as nonArrivedGudinNum,
		sum(t.arrivedGudinN) as arrivedGudinNum,
		sum(t.nonOperationGudinN) as nonOperationGudinNum,
		
		sum(t.nonArrivedTiaoruN) as nonArrivedTiaoruNum,
		sum(t.arrivedTiaoruN) as arrivedTiaoruNum,
		sum(t.nonOperationTiaoruN) as nonOperationTiaoruNum,
		
		sum(t.arrivedBukeN) as arrivedBukeNum,
		sum(t.nonArrivedBukeN) as nonArrivedBukeNum,
		sum(t.nonOperationBukeN) as nonOperationBukeNum
		
		

	from  (
	SELECT
		c.business_id,
		c.name as className,
		c.code as classCode,
		c.single_class_hour  ,
		c.class_hour_duration ,
		a.teacher_id,
		a.create_uid,
		a.class_id,
		a.num AS times_num,
		d.month_archive_time,
	
		( SELECT COUNT( id ) FROM sc_student_times  WHERE deleted=0 and class_id = d.class_id AND times_num = d.times_num AND (trade_status,attend_status) IN ((2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(3,0),(3,1),(4,0),(4,1),(4,2))) AS dueComeNum,
		( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT sc.id ) FROM sc_student_times sc WHERE sc.deleted=0 and sc.class_id = d.class_id AND sc.times_num = d.times_num AND sc.attend_status = 1 AND sc.trade_status !=1  
		 
			and sc.month_archive_time between '2026-02-23 00:00:00' and '2026-02-23 23:59:59'
		 
	 ) AS hadComeNum,
		( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT sc.id ) FROM sc_student_times sc WHERE sc.deleted=0 and sc.class_id = d.class_id AND sc.times_num = d.times_num AND sc.attend_status = 0 AND sc.trade_status !=1  
		 
			and sc.month_archive_time between '2026-02-23 00:00:00' and '2026-02-23 23:59:59'
		 
	 ) AS notComeNum,
		( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT sc.id ) FROM sc_student_times sc WHERE sc.deleted=0 and sc.class_id = d.class_id AND sc.times_num = d.times_num AND sc.attend_status = 2 AND sc.trade_status IN(2,4) ) AS notOperationNum,
		( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT sc.id ) FROM sc_student_times sc WHERE sc.deleted=0 and sc.class_id = d.class_id AND sc.times_num = d.times_num AND sc.attend_check = 0 AND sc.trade_status !=1 AND sc.attend_status !=2  
		 
			and sc.month_archive_time between '2026-02-23 00:00:00' and '2026-02-23 23:59:59'
		 
	 ) AS overtimeNum,
		( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT sc.id ) FROM sc_student_times sc WHERE sc.deleted=0 and sc.class_id = d.class_id AND sc.times_num = d.times_num AND sc.attend_check = 0 AND sc.attend_status =0 AND sc.trade_status !=1  
		 
			and sc.month_archive_time between '2026-02-23 00:00:00' and '2026-02-23 23:59:59'
		 
	 ) AS nonArrivedOvertimeNum,
		( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT sc.id ) FROM sc_student_times sc WHERE sc.deleted=0 and sc.class_id = d.class_id AND sc.times_num = d.times_num AND sc.attend_check = 0 AND sc.attend_status =1 AND sc.trade_status !=1  
		 
			and sc.month_archive_time between '2026-02-23 00:00:00' and '2026-02-23 23:59:59'
		 
	 ) AS arrivedOvertimeNum,
			
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 0 AND d.makeup_status = 0 AND d.attend_status = 1,1,0)) AS arrivedGudinN,
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 0 AND d.makeup_status = 0 AND d.attend_status = 0,1,0)) AS nonArrivedGudinN,
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 0 AND d.makeup_status = 0 AND d.attend_status = 2,1,0)) AS nonOperationGudinN,
	
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 1 AND d.attend_status = 1,1,0)) AS arrivedTiaoruN,
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 1 AND d.attend_status = 0,1,0)) AS nonArrivedTiaoruN,
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 1 AND d.attend_status = 2,1,0)) AS nonOperationTiaoruN,
	
		SUM( IF ( d.makeup_status = 1 AND d.attend_status = 1,1,0)) AS arrivedBukeN,
		SUM( IF ( d.makeup_status = 1 AND d.attend_status = 0,1,0)) AS nonArrivedBukeN,
		SUM( IF ( d.makeup_status = 1 AND d.attend_status = 2,1,0)) AS nonOperationBukeN,
		
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 0 AND d.makeup_status = 0,1,0 )) AS gudinN,
		SUM( IF ( d.transfer_status = 1,1,0)) AS tiaoruN,
		SUM( IF ( d.makeup_status = 1,1,0)) AS bukeN,
	
		(select count(DISTINCT id) from sc_students_attend_record where deleted = 0 and  a.class_id = class_id AND a.num = times_num and last_attend_status = 2 and attend_status =1  and wf_order_id is not null) AS twoToOneNum,
		(select count(DISTINCT id) from sc_students_attend_record where deleted = 0 and  a.class_id = class_id AND a.num = times_num and last_attend_status = 2 and attend_status =0  and wf_order_id is not null) AS  twoToZeroNum,
		(select count(DISTINCT id) from sc_students_attend_record where deleted = 0 and  a.class_id = class_id AND a.num = times_num and last_attend_status = 1 and attend_status =0  and wf_order_id is not null) AS oneToZeroNum,
		(select count(DISTINCT id) from sc_students_attend_record where deleted = 0 and  a.class_id = class_id AND a.num = times_num and last_attend_status = 0 and attend_status =1  and wf_order_id is not null) AS  zeroToOneNum
	FROM
		pc_class_times a
		INNER JOIN pc_class c ON a.class_id = c.id
		LEFT JOIN sc_student_times d ON a.class_id = d.class_id AND a.num = d.times_num
		 
			inner join sc_re_student_times_month_auto_archive_record r on d.id = r.stuentent_times_id
		 
		where 
			a.deleted = 0 
			AND d.deleted = 0 
			AND a.close_class_type = 0 
			AND ( d.trade_status, d.attend_status ) IN ((2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(3,0),(3,1),(4,0),(4,1),(4,2))
			AND a.STATUS != 'RELEASE' 
			 
			 
				AND r.month_auto_archive_record_id = 25
			 
			 
				AND c.business_id = 1
			 
			 
			 
				AND d.month_archive_time >= '2026-02-23 00:00:00'
			 
			 
				AND d.month_archive_time <= '2026-02-23 23:59:59'
			 
			GROUP BY a.class_id,a.num
			ORDER BY a.begin_time DESC
	) t
	LEFT JOIN uc_staff sa ON sa.user_id = t.teacher_id
	GROUP BY sa.job_no
	ORDER BY
	sa.job_no ASC)tab

SELECT
        sum(tab.studyNum) as beingRead,
        sum(tab.quota1) as accommodate,
        CONCAT(ROUND(sum(tab.studyNum)/sum(tab.quota1)*100 ,2),"%") as rate
        FROM
        (
        SELECT
         
         
            (
            SELECT
            COUNT( DISTINCT sc.student_id, sc.class_id )
            FROM
            sc_student_class_record sc
            JOIN (SELECT max(scr.operate_time) as max_operation_time, scr.id,scr.class_id,student_id FROM sc_student_class_record scr
            WHERE
            scr.deleted = 0
            AND '2026-03-01 23:59:59' >= scr.operate_time
            GROUP BY scr.class_id,scr.student_id)scr
            ON sc.operate_time = scr.max_operation_time and scr.class_id = sc.class_id and sc.student_id = scr.student_id
            WHERE
            sc.deleted = 0
            AND sc.join_type IN (1,2)
            AND sc.class_id = t1.id
            )studyNum,
         
        if((ol.status is null and t1.class_mode=1
         
            and '2026-03-01 23:59:59' >= t1.create_time
         )
        or (ol.status=2 and t1.class_mode=1
         
            and '2026-03-01 23:59:59' >= ol.audit_time
         )
        ,t1.quota,0) quota1,
        t2.quota
        FROM
        pc_class t1
        JOIN pc_course t2 ON t1.course_id = t2.id
        JOIN trade_goods_sale_mgr t3 on t3.spec_id=t1.id and t3.deleted=false
        LEFT join pf_process_order_last ol on ol.wf_order_id=t3.wf_order_id
        left join bd_class_type bct on bct.id = t2.class_type_id
        left join bd_course_series bcs on t2.course_series_id=bcs.id
        WHERE
        t1.deleted = 0 and t3.channel=1 and t3.status=3 and t1.class_mode=1
         
                and (t1.status != 4 or (t1.status = 4 and t1.close_time >= '2026-03-01 23:59:59'))
             
         
            AND t2.course_type_id = 1
         
         
            and t1.business_id IN
             (  
                2
             ) 
         
         
         

         
         
            and t2.class_year_id IN
             (  
                5
             ) 
         
         
            AND t2.class_semester_id IN
             (  
                2
             ) 
         
         
            AND t2.grade_id IN
             (  
                13
             ) 
         
         
            AND t2.subject_id IN
             (  
                2
             ) 
         

         
            and t1.campus_id in
             (  
                10
             ) 
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
        ) tab

select 
A.mall_bi_id,
A.created_at,
A.created_at_ymonth,
A.spend_count_day,
B.spend_count_day_GC,
C.spend_count_day_SC,
D.spend_count_day_RC,
A1.shop_count_day,
B1.shop_count_day_GC,
C1.shop_count_day_SC,
D1.shop_count_day_RC,
E1.shop_count_month,
F1.shop_count_month_GC,
G1.shop_count_month_SC,
H1.shop_count_month_RC
from
-- 昨日交易笔数
(SELECT 
mall_bi_id,
created_at,
left(created_at,7) as created_at_ymonth,
COUNT(member_id) AS spend_count_day
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER 
WHERE created_at = '2026-02-28'
-- 按照时间门店分组
group by mall_bi_id,created_at
) A
left join 
(SELECT 
a.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
a.created_at as created_at,
left(a.created_at,7) as created_ymonth,
COUNT(a.member_id) AS spend_count_day_GC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER a
left join 
-- 获取卡类型
(select member_id, member_level_id from bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER where  member_level_id='406') b
on a.member_id=b.member_id
WHERE a.created_at  = '2026-02-28'
and b.member_level_id is not null -- 剔除非金卡会员
-- 按照时间门店分组
group by a.mall_bi_id,a.created_at
) B
on A.mall_bi_id = B.mall_bi_id and A.created_at= B.created_at
left join 
(SELECT 
a.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
a.created_at as created_at,
left(a.created_at,7) as created_ymonth,
COUNT(a.member_id) AS spend_count_day_SC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER a
left join 
-- 获取卡类型
(select member_id, member_level_id from bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER where  member_level_id='405') b
on a.member_id=b.member_id
WHERE a.created_at = '2026-02-28'
and b.member_level_id is not null -- 剔除非银卡会员 
-- 按照时间门店分组
group by a.mall_bi_id,a.created_at
) C
on A.mall_bi_id = C.mall_bi_id and A.created_at= C.created_at
left join 
(SELECT 
a.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
a.created_at as created_at,
left(a.created_at,7) as created_ymonth,
COUNT(a.member_id) AS spend_count_day_RC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER a
left join 
-- 获取卡类型
(select member_id, member_level_id from bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER where  member_level_id='404') b
on a.member_id=b.member_id
WHERE a.created_at = '2026-02-28'
and b.member_level_id is not null-- 剔除非普卡会员 
-- 按照时间门店分组
group by a.mall_bi_id,a.created_at
) D
on A.mall_bi_id = D.mall_bi_id and A.created_at= D.created_at
left join 
(SELECT 
mall_bi_id,
created_at,
COUNT(DISTINCT member_id ) AS shop_count_day
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER 
WHERE created_at = '2026-02-28'
group by mall_bi_id,created_at 
) A1
on A.mall_bi_id= A1.mall_bi_id and A.created_at = A1.created_at
left join 
(SELECT 
c.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
c.created_at as created_at,
COUNT(DISTINCT  c.member_id ) AS shop_count_day_GC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER c
left join bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER a
on a.member_id=c.member_id
WHERE c.created_at = '2026-02-28'
and a.member_level_id='406'
group by c.mall_bi_id,c.created_at
) B1
on A.mall_bi_id=B1.mall_bi_id and A.created_at = B1.created_at
left join
(SELECT 
c.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
c.created_at as created_at,
COUNT(DISTINCT  c.member_id ) AS shop_count_day_SC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER c
left join bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER a
on a.member_id=c.member_id
WHERE c.created_at = '2026-02-28'
and a.member_level_id='405'
group by c.mall_bi_id,c.created_at
)C1
on A.mall_bi_id =C1.mall_bi_id and A.created_at=C1.created_at
left join
(SELECT 
c.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
c.created_at as created_at,
COUNT(DISTINCT  c.member_id ) AS shop_count_day_RC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER c
left join bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER a
on a.member_id=c.member_id
WHERE c.created_at = '2026-02-28'
and a.member_level_id='404'
group by c.mall_bi_id,c.created_at
) D1
on A.mall_bi_id=D1.mall_bi_id and A.created_at = D1.created_at
left join
(SELECT 
mall_bi_id,
COUNT(DISTINCT member_id ) AS shop_count_month
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER 
WHERE created_at between CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-28','%Y-%m-01'))  and  '2026-02-28'
group by mall_bi_id
)E1
on A.mall_bi_id = E1.mall_bi_id
left join 
(SELECT 
c.mall_bi_id,
COUNT(DISTINCT  c.member_id ) AS shop_count_month_GC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER c
left join bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER a
on a.member_id=c.member_id

and a.member_level_id='406'
group by c.mall_bi_id
) F1
on A.mall_bi_id = F1.mall_bi_id
left join
(SELECT 
c.mall_bi_id,
COUNT(DISTINCT  c.member_id ) AS shop_count_month_SC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER c
left join bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER a
on a.member_id=c.member_id
WHERE c.created_at between CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-28','%Y-%m-01'))  and  '2026-02-28'
and a.member_level_id='405'
group by c.mall_bi_id
) G1
on A.mall_bi_id = G1.mall_bi_id
left join 
(SELECT 
c.mall_bi_id,
COUNT(DISTINCT  c.member_id ) AS shop_count_month_RC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER c
left join bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER a

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT X.* ,Y.*,IFNULL(X.amount/IF(IFNULL(y.customer_num,0)=0,1,customer_num),0) as customer_amount FROM (SELECT
        I.code as mall,
        I.`NAME`,
        DATE_FORMAT(R.BOOK_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') billdate,
        COUNT(1) 客单总数,
        SUM(IF(A.AMOUNT<0,-1,1)) 有效客单数1,
        SUM(A.NUM) num,
        SUM(A.AMOUNT + A.DISC_AMOUNT) ysje,
        SUM(A.AMOUNT) amount,
        SUM(A.DISC_AMOUNT) 折扣金额,
        SUM(A.PREF_AMOUNT) PREF_AMOUNT FROM
        jpaas_erp.ERP_SALE_REC_GOOD A
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.erp_sale_rec R ON(A.POS_NO=R.POS_NO AND A.REC_ID=R.REC_ID)
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.ERP_SYS_GOODS G ON(A.GOOD_ID = G.ID_)
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.ERP_SYS_CATEGORY C ON(G.CATEGROY = C.CODE)
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.ERP_CONTRACT_SHOP S ON(A.DEPT_ID=S.ID_ )
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.ERP_CONTRACT H ON(S.REF_ID_=H.ID_)
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.erp_sys_mall I ON(H.MALL =I.`CODE`)
        WHERE 1=1

         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
            and I.code in

                '101041'

                '101051'

                '101061'
             , 
                '10198'
             , 
                '10199'
             , 
                '10401'
             , 
                '10402'
             , 
                '10403'
             , 
                '10404'
             ) 
         

        GROUP BY I.NAME,R.BOOK_DATE)X LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        I.code as code2,
        I.`NAME`  as name2,
        DATE_FORMAT(R.BOOK_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') billdate2,
        COUNT(1) 客单总数2,
        SUM(IF(R.AMOUNT<0,-1,1)) customer_num
        FROM  jpaas_erp.erp_sale_rec R
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.erp_person_def P ON(R.CASHIER_ID=P.ID_)
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.ERP_CONTRACT_SHOP S ON(P.SHOPID=S.ID_ )
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.ERP_CONTRACT H ON(S.REF_ID_=H.ID_)
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.ERP_SYS_CATEGORY C ON(S.CATEGORY = C.CODE)
        LEFT JOIN jpaas_erp.erp_sys_mall I ON(H.MALL =I.`CODE`)
        WHERE 1=1

         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
            and I.code in

                '10198'
             , 
                '10199'

                '10401'

courseSeriesName, (SELECT name FROM bd_class_type WHERE id = a.class_type_id) AS classTypeIdName, (SELECT name FROM bd_course_type_item WHERE id = a.course_type_item_id) AS courseTypeItemName, toi.content_unit_price, g.class_type AS class_type, g.campus_id AS campusId, h.name AS campusName, m.nickname AS teacherName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.NAME) FROM bd_campus d1 LEFT JOIN pc_class d2 ON d1.id = d2.campus_id LEFT JOIN sc_student_times d3 ON d3.class_id = d2.id WHERE d3.trace_id = toi.trace_id) AS otoCampusName, (SELECT ca.`name` FROM bd_campus ca WHERE ca.id = a.campus_id) AS order_campus_name, toi.order_item_num, toi.total_num AS totalNum, toi.unit_price AS price, toi.total_amount AS totalAmount, toi.act_deduct_amount, toi.ct_deduct_amount, toi.ct_deduct_diff_amount, ifnull((SELECT sum(d.discount_amount) FROM trade_order_item_discount d WHERE d.deleted = false AND d.order_item_id = toi.id AND d.type = 'special'), 0) specialDiscount, ifnull((SELECT sum(d.discount_amount) FROM trade_order_item_discount d WHERE d.deleted = false AND d.order_item_id = toi.id AND d.type = 'coupon'), 0) couponDiscount, ifnull((SELECT sum(d.discount_amount) FROM trade_order_item_discount d WHERE d.deleted = false AND d.order_item_id = toi.id AND d.type = 'activity'), 0) activityDiscount, ifnull((SELECT sum(d.discount_amount) FROM trade_order_item_discount d WHERE d.deleted = false AND d.order_item_id = toi.id AND d.type = 'student'), 0) studentDiscount, toi.discount_total_amount AS discountTotalAmount, toi.payable_amount AS payableAmount, toi.practical_amount AS practicalAmount, (toi.payable_amount - toi.act_deduct_amount - toi.ct_deduct_amount) AS actualPaymentAmount, e.order_num AS orderNum, e.order_status AS orderStatus, e.pay_create_time AS payCreateTime, e.create_time AS orderCreateTime, b.name AS productName, b.code AS productCode, b.type AS productType, c.NAME AS goodsName, f.name AS studentName, f.number AS studentNo, i.name AS courseSystemName, j.name AS courseTypeName, k.name AS gradeName, l.name AS subjectName, n.name AS orderSource, o.nickname AS signOrderUserName, s.name AS businessName, e.type order_type, e.business_id, t1.* FROM trade_order_course_item a LEFT JOIN trade_order_item toi ON a.order_item_id = toi.id LEFT JOIN pc_class g ON a.class_id = g.id LEFT JOIN bd_campus h ON g.campus_id = h.id LEFT JOIN uc_user m ON g.teacher_id = m.id LEFT JOIN trade_product b ON toi.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN trade_goods c ON toi.goods_id = c.id LEFT JOIN pc_course d ON toi.product_id = d.product_id LEFT JOIN trade_order e ON toi.order_id = e.id LEFT JOIN rc_student f ON f.id = e.student_id LEFT JOIN pc_course_system i ON d.course_system_id = i.id LEFT JOIN bd_course_type j ON d.course_type_id = j.id LEFT JOIN bd_grade k ON d.grade_id = k.id LEFT JOIN bd_subject l ON d.subject_id = l.id LEFT JOIN uc_app n ON e.app_id = n.id LEFT JOIN uc_user o ON e.sign_order_user_id = o.id LEFT JOIN bc_business s ON e.business_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.description) pay_description, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.pay_type) pay_type, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.payment_method) payment_method, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT (CASE d1.payment_method_subtype WHEN 1 THEN '私对公转账' WHEN 2 THEN '公对公转账' ELSE '' END)) payment_method_subtype_name, MIN(d1.receipt_time) pay_receipt_time, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d2.nickname) pay_receipt_user_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d3.NAME) pay_receipt_campus_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d4.NAME) pay_app_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d5.account_name) pay_account_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d5.account) pay_account, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.pay_portal) pay_portal, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.pay_mch_id) pay_mch_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.trade_no) pay_trade_no, d1.order_id FROM trade_order_payment d1 LEFT JOIN uc_user d2 ON d1.receipt_user_id = d2.id LEFT JOIN bd_campus d3 ON d3.id = d1.receipt_campus_id LEFT JOIN uc_app d4 ON d4.id = d1.app_id LEFT JOIN bd_account d5 ON d5.id = d1.account_id GROUP BY d1.order_id) t1 ON t1.order_id = e.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND e.order_status = 1 AND e.pay_create_time >= '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AND e.pay_create_time <= '2026-02-28 23:59:59' AND e.business_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 209, -1) ORDER BY e.last_receipt_time DESC

a.`own_cross_month_refund_num`, IFNULL(z.`fans_total_num`, 0) fans_total_num, IFNULL(c.`fans_new_num`, 0) fans_new_num, IFNULL(c.`live_session_count`, 0) live_session_count, c.`live_effective_session_count`, c.`avg_thousand_count`, c.`pm_reply_less3min_count_scale` FROM (SELECT id, dealer_name, dealer_code, d.main_area_id, d.child_area_id, d.city_id FROM `nmo_dealer_info` CONCAT('A01A03', '%'))) q LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT `t`.`dealer_id` AS dealer_id, `d`.`dealer_name` AS dealer_name, sum(`t`.`produce_num`) AS `produce_num`, sum(`t`.`live_clue_num`) AS `live_clue_num`, LEFT JOIN `nmo_media_platform` `mp` ON `t`.`platform_id` = `mp`.`id` WHERE t.stat_date >= '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AND t.stat_date < '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND mp.platform_code = 'DY' AND (d.dealer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', '41611', '%') OR d.dealer_code = '41611') AND t.dealer_id IN (SELECT id FROM `sys_depart` WHERE org_code LIKE CONCAT('A01A03', '%')) GROUP BY `t`.`dealer_id`, `d`.`dealer_name`) a ON q.id = a.dealer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `t`.`dealer_id` AS dealer_id, IFNULL(SUM(other_num), 0) AS other_num, IFNULL(SUM(contact_num), 0) AS other_contact_num, IFNULL(SUM(first_contact_num), 0) AS other_first_contact_num, IFNULL(SUM(arrive_num), 0) AS other_arrive_num, IFNULL(SUM(deal_num), 0) AS other_deal_num, IFNULL(SUM(cross_month_refund_num), 0) AS other_cross_month_refund_num FROM `nmo_stat_clue_other` `t` LEFT JOIN `nmo_dealer_info` `d` ON `t`.`dealer_id` = `d`.`id` WHERE t.stat_date >= '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AND t.stat_date < '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND t.platform_id = (SELECT id FROM `nmo_media_platform` WHERE platform_code = 'DY') AND (d.dealer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', '41611', '%') OR d.dealer_code = '41611') AND t.dealer_id IN (SELECT id FROM `sys_depart` WHERE org_code LIKE CONCAT('A01A03', '%')) GROUP BY `t`.`dealer_id`) b ON q.id = b.dealer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `t`.`dealer_id` AS dealer_id, sum(IFNULL(`t`.`fans_new_num`, 0)) AS `fans_new_num`, round(sum(IFNULL(`t`.`live_produce_num`, 0)) * 1000 / sum(IFNULL(`t`.`live_view_ucount`, 0)), 2) AS avg_thousand_count, concat(round(sum(IFNULL(pm_reply_less3min_count, 0)) * 100 / sum(IFNULL(pm_receive_count, 0)), 2), '%') AS pm_reply_less3min_count_scale FROM `nmo_stat_account` `t` LEFT JOIN `nmo_dealer_info` `d` ON `t`.`dealer_id` = `d`.`id` LEFT JOIN `nmo_media_account` `mc` ON `t`.`account_id` = `mc`.`id` LEFT JOIN `nmo_media_platform` `mp` ON `t`.`platform_id` = `mp`.`id` WHERE t.stat_date >= '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AND t.stat_date < '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND mp.platform_code = 'DY' AND (d.dealer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', '41611', '%') OR d.dealer_code = '41611') AND t.dealer_id IN (SELECT id FROM `sys_depart` WHERE org_code LIKE CONCAT('A01A03', '%')) GROUP BY `t`.`dealer_id`) c ON q.id = c.dealer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT dealer_id, SUM(fans_total_num) AS fans_total_num FROM (SELECT t.dealer_id, t.account_id, MAX(t.stat_date) AS stat_date, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(t.fans_total_num ORDER BY t.stat_date DESC), ',', 1) AS fans_total_num FROM `nmo_stat_account` t LEFT JOIN `nmo_dealer_info` `d` ON `t`.`dealer_id` = `d`.`id` LEFT JOIN `nmo_media_platform` `mp` ON `t`.`platform_id` = `mp`.`id` WHERE t.`fans_total_num` IS NOT NULL AND t.stat_date >= '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AND t.stat_date < '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND mp.platform_code =
